text:
mira: Quick design/eng sync: audit log navigation + RBAC cross-talk. Users find it hard to correlate an invite event with the role change in the roles matrix. They want a keyboard-first flow to jump from an audit row -> open role detail -> revoke/grant. Thinking: add a "Jump to role" action inline in the audit item. dave: Nice. How would that work for SSO toggles? If SSO enforcement flips, invites behavior changes and audit entries get messy. We should surface an inline badge in the audit row: "SSO on" with tooltip and make it focusable. sam: Implementation outline: add a small action link after the timestamp: [Jump to role] (button) that focuses the corresponding role row and highlights it for 3s. For SR users, announce "Focusing role: Developers" via aria-live polite. Also set focus management so keyboard users land in the role panel header. keiko: Love it but accessibility nit: moving focus suddenly can be disorienting. Instead consider providing a skip link pattern: when you activate Jump to role, add a visible skip link at top of page "Go to Developers role details" which receives focus and is stable. Then pressing Enter moves you. Or keep the direct focus but provide an alert using aria-live that something changed and how to navigate back. mira: Good call. UX decision: directly focus the role header and show a small toast "Focusing Developers (press Esc to return)" with role-specific context. Esc returns focus to the audit row. For SR: aria-live politely announces "Now focused: Developers role panel. Press Escape to return to audit list." audit-bot: Accessibility checks: 1) Ensure Jump to role is a real button (not link) with aria-controls pointing to role panel id; 2) Use aria-describedby for the toast; 3) Ensure Escape restores previous focus; 4) Test NVDA/VoiceOver for focus transitions. dave: Also: keyboard shortcut idea: when audit list is focused, pressing "r" focuses revoke action for selected row. But this might conflict with browser shortcuts or existing app shortcuts. We should require a modifier (Shift+R) and document it in help. sam: Implementation constraints: list virtualization means role element might not be in DOM. Jump-to-role must scroll and render the role row before focusing. We'll need to await the row render and then focus, with a11y-friendly announcement during the wait: "Loading role details" via aria-live. keiko: Copy notes: toast text should be short and specific: use sentence case, e.g., "Focusing Developers role panel. Press Esc to return to audit list." Use single quotes around role names? be consistent. mira: Also add a filter pill in audit UI "Show RBAC events" which toggles to only invite/role/revoke events. Clicking a pill should be keyboard operable and should set focus to first item in filtered list. aria-pressed semantics for the pill. dave: For SSO-related events, include a quick filter "SSO enforced" that shows only audit rows where SSO policy impacted the action. That filter should also be available as a URL param so support teams can link directly. Test that the filter state announces via aria-live when toggled. sam: Small DOM sketch for Jump-to-role button in audit row: ```
Mar 10 Invite sent to ali@example.com
``` Role panel: ```

Developers

``` We focus the H3 after render. keiko: Ensure h3 has tabindex=-1 for programmatic focus. Also ensure focus outlines are visible; don't hide them with mouse-only styles. mira: QA asks: please add unit/e2e tests that assert focus ends up in role h3 and that Esc restores to audit row. Also add axe-core rule passes for aria-controls. audit-bot: Checklist: 1) Jump to role is a button with aria-controls; 2) Use aria-live messages for transitions; 3) Handle virtualized lists by awaiting render; 4) Provide Esc to return focus; 5) Announce SSO filter changes; 6) Add keyboard shortcut guidelines and opt-in modifier; 7) Update support links with filter params. dave: One more: when multiple audit rows map to same role, Jump to role should indicate the event that triggered the highlight (e.g., highlight role and outline the specific permission change). SR text should include that: "Focusing Developers role panel. Change: Grant 'write' permission to group 'analytics'." sam: Good point. We'll include an aria-describedby on the role header that the toast references with details. keiko: Let's prototype in storybook with keyboard walkthrough GIFs and NVDA/VoiceOver narration scripts. mira: Target: small PR this sprint to add Jump to role + RBAC audit filters. Please attach accessibility testing notes in PR. Thanks! :heart:
